products.product_description: Nestle Coffee-Mate Coffee Creamer, Original Flavor, packaged as 3/8 fl oz single serve tubs.50 single serve tubs are packaged in a self dispensing fiberboard box. Four fiberboard boxes are packaged in a case.
products.code_info: UPC code on the 50 count box: 50000-351107. A production code on the 50 count box: 214651186 with a time stamp from 2:30 to 3:34. Best buy date on 50 count box: Mar 2013
products.reason_for_recall: Nestle Professional Vitality initiated a recall on 10/9/12 of their Nestle COFFEE-MATE Original Liquid Creamer Singles due to a manufacturing error that causes the creamer to become acidic.
